verdict.rationale: The Minnesota Secretary of State is a government business-filing and registry service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-facing integration endpoint. The portal is a login-gated web rail, and the probes show bot-management CAPTCHA walls for keyless agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
